description: Tests whether a small set of transparent, pregame-available uncertainty factors (sample depth, missingness, model extremeness, component disagreement, early-season state) predictably relate to realized team-run and probability error, using MLB-RSCH-0009's own frozen {offense,bullpen} baseline model. Does not change any production confidence, qualification, staking, or sizing logic.
name: mlb_rsch_0019_uncertainty_prediction_control_v1
probabilityAdapterIdentity: lib.edgelab.backtest.run_distributions (frozen MLB-RSCH-0010 negative-binomial, dispersion unchanged, never refit here)
